message.name: SecuritiesStatementQuery002V08
message.definition: Scope|An account owner sends a SecuritiesStatementQuery to an account servicer to request any existing securities statement.|The account owner/servicer relationship may be:|- a global custodian which has an account with a local custodian, or|- an investment management institution which manage a fund account opened at a custodian, or|- a broker which has an account with a custodian, or|- a central securities depository participant which has an account with a central securities depository, or|- a central securities depository which has an account with a custodian, another central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure, or|- a central counterparty or a stock exchange or a trade matching utility which need to instruct to a central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure.||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information|using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

rules.name: ShortLongNumberRule
rules.text: ShortNumber must contain the FIN message type number of the linked message. LongNumber must contain the XML message identifier of the linked message.

rules.name: StatementTypeRule
rules.text: If StatementType is used, then the statement requested must be a SecuritiesBalanceAccountingReport, a SecuritiesBalanceCustodyReport or a SecuritiesTransactionPostingReport.

rules.name: StatementBasisRule
rules.text: If StatementBasis is used, then the statement requested must be a SecuritiesBalanceAccountingReport or a SecuritiesBalanceCustodyReport.

rules.name: StatusRule
rules.text: If a specific Status is requested, then it must be in line with the statuses available for the message type requested.

rules.name: ReasonRule
rules.text: If the reason is requested, then it must be in line with the reasons available for the message type requested.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When a ISIN code exist. It is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rule
rules.text: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rule
rules.text: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Rule
rules.text: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.
